before: id="import-auto-id1403686">There is a latency period for the onset of radiation-induced cancer of about 2 years for leukemia and 15 years for most other forms. The person is at risk for at least 30 years after the latency period
after: xmlns="http://cnx.rice.edu/cnxml" xmlns:m="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" id="import-auto-id1403686">Radiation-induced cancers can appear years after exposure. Among Hiroshima and Nagasaki survivors, leukemia began to increase about 2–3 years after exposure, and solid cancers about 10 years after exposure. Increased cancer risk can persist for decades
